name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno, Nevada-based royalty and mineral property company focused on acquiring and exploring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada and Idaho. The company's portfolio includes the Lazy Claims, Loman, Agai-Pah, and Swales Properties in Mineral and Elko Counties, Nevada, plus the Belshazzar Property in Idaho, with a low-overhead royalty model that limits exposure to traditional mining operating costs. Nevada Canyon trades on the OTCQX Best Market and in 2024 acquired a 2% net smelter returns royalty on the Lapon Canyon Project in Mineral County, Nevada.
